desc: Full visual rehearsal for the livecode.nyc show (2026-07-19). Twelve scenes, hand-written p5 throughout plus catalog components and the three.js Little Martians surface: penguins → synthwave city → deep-space nebula → space disco/ballroom → mystical cathedral with dinosaurs → Basquiat → Van Gogh×Picasso → Dalí dreamscape → Little Martians (flock/library/journey) → thank you. Visual-only: the music seat was never touched this session.
